name: dsh-penguin-playground
description: DSH web plugin: penguin playground — a 2D Gentoo penguin desktop pet (side view) animated by a spring-joint engine, plus penguin theme tokens, an input-row easter-egg button, a status dock and a settings section. v1.2 adds projectile-defecation ballistics (tokens burned become poop, aimed into one growing pile that explodes at 40); v1.2.1 reworks that action (body leans forward, flippers swept back, tail up, then a shake), fixes mirrored poses when the pet faces left, and retunes the eye patch; v1.2.2 cancels a pending jump when the action starts, so triggering it mid-hop no longer gets swallowed by the landing.
